race.comment: SILVER SNOW (4) goes on top, coming off a maiden at Cranbourne where he drove hard late to beat Shields and now keeps Dylan Dunn aboard. This looks a very winnable option to progress to and he should go close again. BAKERSBEND (1) has been close enough in stronger recent form lines, with excuses at Bendigo and another solid fourth at Echuca. He's going well enough to win this. SAVETHEBESTTILLAST (9) is harder to sell as a winner, but his two placings from two runs at this track read well and he'll get a soft run. KING'S TAJ (5) is a rough hope through some solid picnic form.
